name: travel-photo-soft-abstraction
title_zh: 把旅行照片蒸馏成上实下虚的编辑部式艺术图
tagline_zh: 原图上半保留不动，下半生成可读的柔和抽象——附编号、日期、短语。不是风格迁移，是克制的视觉蒸馏。
tagline_en: Keep the original photo intact above; generate a soft, readable abstraction below—with number, date, and a short.
desc_en: Analyze a user-uploaded travel photograph and reconstruct it as a CLEAN upper-photo/lower-abstraction editorial artwork. Use when Codex should preserve the original photo unchanged above, generate a source-readable softly abstract lower panel guided by bundled references, and add a number, date, and short phrase. This is subtle visual distillation, not style transfer, heavy symbolism, or a miniatu
why_zh: 它把“分析照片”和“生成抽象”分成两段：上半原图零改动，下半由内置参考图引导，保证抽象有来源、可追溯。
why_en: It splits analysis from generation: the upper half stays untouched, while the lower half is guided by bundled reference.
limit_zh: 只接受单张上传的旅行照片；不处理人像特写或含密集文字的街景。抽象面板仅限下半，不会扩展成整幅重绘。输出为静态PNG。
limit_en: Single travel photo only; no portraits or text-heavy street scenes. Abstraction stays in the lower panel—never full-frame. Output is static PNG, no.
title_en: Distill a travel photo into an editorial.
